description: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, and the y-axis represents the WER, ranging from 30 to 70. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different amount of weights: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny AdaLoRA_int8, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny full. The lines show a general trend of decreasing WER as the number of epochs increases. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at the highest WER of 70 and ends at the lowest WER of 30, while the tiny full line starts at the lowest WER of 30 and ends at the highest WER of 70. The other lines show a similar trend of decreasing WER as the number of epochs increases.
